recognize_zh: 淋巴結觸片（Romanowsky 染色）：可見許多大型淋巴樣細胞，核圓或有凹陷裂紋、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質少量淡藍色，夾雜較小的中心細胞樣細胞，背景有淋巴腺小體（lymphoglandular bodies）；大型中心母細胞比例高，符合高級別濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Many large lymphoid cells (centroblast-like) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Admixed smaller cells with cleaved, notched or folded nuclei (centrocyte-like)
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background of lymphoglandular bodies and scattered red blood cells
No tingible body macrophages or mixed inflammatory cells in this field
describe_en: Touch preparation of the lymph node (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a cellular population of atypical lymphoid cells in a background of lymphoglandular bodies and scattered red blood cells. Many cells are large, with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm, admixed with smaller cells bearing cleaved or notched nuclei. Tingible body macrophages, plasma cells and other reactive elements are not evident in this field. The cytology indicates a B-cell lymphoma of follicle-center type with a high proportion of large cells, consistent with high-grade follicular lymphoma in correlation with histology; grading cannot be established on cytology alone.

ddx.vs: DLBCL touch preps look similar cytologically; separation requires tissue architecture showing diffuse rather than follicular growth.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing many lipid vacuoles and numerous tingible body macrophages.
Reactive touch preps show a polymorphous mixture dominated by small lymphocytes with tingible body macrophages, plasma cells and immunoblasts.
